svg.title: How the radix tree inserts, splits, matches, locks and evicts
svg.desc: Memory runs low and evict asks for three tokens. Only leaves with lock_ref 0 can be evicted, so the a-node, locked by C, is safe. The b-node is popped from the heap, its slots 7 to 9 return to the free pool, and the leaf is deleted.
svg.text: HEAP BY LAST_ACCESS_TIME → POP B-NODE · FREE KV 7 8 9
Tree node / KV slot owned by tree
